_note: PLACEHOLDER priors. Copy to industries.json (gitignored) and replace with your own, tuned from closed-won data. The round numbers below are illustrative defaults, not researched benchmarks — they exist so a fresh clone runs and the tests pass. Every value here is an assumption the brief prints as an assumption and never as a fact.

_fields.avgValue: Dollar value of one new customer (first job, not lifetime).
_fields.closeRate: Share of inbound leads that become paying customers.
_fields.missedCallPct: Share of inbound calls that go unanswered, before any fix.
_fields.noShowPct: Share of booked appointments that no-show or cancel.
_fields.customersPerReview: How many served customers produce one public review. Used to back into lead volume from review velocity — the weakest inference in the system.
_fields.seasonality: Free text the rep can use for timing.
_fields.afterHoursMatters: Whether after-hours coverage is a real buying trigger in this vertical.
